text:
I checked the task-system-audit proposal, and `text-check` found nothing. I rewrote one thing: the title. It now asks only the question, "Tasks: is the task system working? Measure it, then say what must change". The "you are a mastermind, on Sonnet…" instructions had been in the title, so I moved them to an italic line under it.

I read the proposal's text but didn't shoot a page, since the task has no `page.js`. I edited only `requirements.md` and logged a "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`.
